title: A GFF limit for triangular odd heights with two boundary arcs
exact_target: For uniform odd integer Lipschitz heights on triangular-lattice approximations of a smooth simply connected planar domain with the stated two-arc boundary data, does the height distribution converge to the harmonic boundary extension plus sigma times the domain GFF, for a universal $\sigma >0$, with convergence of every joint test-function moment and mean?
